title: Credo Beauty and Revieve partner to make beauty discovery smarter, more personal, and more intuitive
summary: New digital experiences combine Credo Beauty's commitment to efficacy, safety, and sustainability with Revieve's AI-powered personalisation technology, helping consumers discover skincare routines and foundation matches tailored to their individual needs
